# k3d_secret (Resource)

A Kubernetes Secret. Set `data` to keep values in Terraform state with change detection, or `data_wo` with `data_wo_version` to keep them out of state. Creating one that already exists fails: import it instead. For a pull secret, set `type = "kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson"` and `.dockerconfigjson = jsonencode({ auths = { ... } })`. Import with `<cluster>/<namespace>/<name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "ghcr_auth" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "k3d_secret" "api" {
  cluster         = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace       = k3d_namespace.app.name
  name            = "api"
  data_wo         = { token = var.api_token }
  data_wo_version = 1
}

resource "k3d_secret" "ghcr" {
  cluster   = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace = k3d_namespace.app.name
  name      = "ghcr"
  type      = "kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson"

  data_wo = {
    ".dockerconfigjson" = jsonencode({
      auths = { "ghcr.io" = { auth = var.ghcr_auth } }
    })
  }
  data_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations. Only keys set here are tracked, so ones added by controllers do not show as changes.
- `cluster` (String) Cluster to manage the object in, usually `k3d_cluster.<name>.id`, so the object is recreated when the cluster is replaced. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Keys and plain text values, stored in Terraform state. Only keys set here are tracked.
- `data_wo` (Map of String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Keys and plain text values that never reach plan or state. Terraform cannot detect changes to them, so bump `data_wo_version` to apply new values. Needs Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `data_wo_version` (Number) Change this to apply the current `data_wo` values.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster that is reached directly and not through Docker. Not recorded as a dependency on the cluster's lifetime, so prefer `cluster` for clusters in the same configuration. It is stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted state backend.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels, such as `argocd.argoproj.io/secret-type`. Only keys set here are tracked, so ones added by controllers do not show as changes.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the object. Defaults to `default`.
- `type` (String) Secret type. Defaults to `Opaque`.

### Read-Only

- `data_hash` (String) Changes when the data changes. Use it as a pod template annotation to restart workloads when the secret changes. With `data_wo` it only reflects `data_wo_version`, so no value derived from the secret reaches state.
- `id` (String) `<cluster>/<namespace>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_secret.api demo/app/api
```
